lede: This is JVTO's proof library: a locker of legal, Tourist Police authority, safety, and historical documents for PT Java Volcano Rendezvous (NIB 1102230032918), each one checkable against an independent government or third-party source.
Most operators ask you to take licensing on trust. JVTO publishes the actual registry IDs and signed document scans so you can confirm every claim yourself — before you pay a deposit.

blocks.body_md:
The locker is organised into four proof layers. Each has its own page with the underlying documents and independent verification links:

- **Legal & Licenses** (/verify-jvto/legal) — NIB and TDUP under identifier 1102230032918, the AHU corporate registry entry, and HPWKI membership, all searchable on Indonesian government registries.
- **Police & Safety** (/verify-jvto/police-safety) — founder Bripka Agung Sambuko's SPRIN-POLPAR and SPRIN-WAL-TRAVEL assignment orders, plus independent press confirmation of his role as an active Tourist Police (Ditpamobvit) officer.
- **Press & Recognition** (/verify-jvto/press-recognition) — the Stefan Loose guidebook editorial listing (ISBN-13 9783770167654, page 287), Detik.com and Radar Jember coverage, and the Booking.com 2015 Guest Review Award.
- **History & Artifacts** (/verify-jvto/history-artifacts) — the documented continuity from the 2015 guesthouse era through the 2023 PT formalization.

---

Every document in the locker carries a published SHA-256 hash so you can detect tampering yourself:

- **Open the evidence locker** — browse the document grid on this page and select any item.
- **Read the metadata** — each card shows the official title, context, verified date, and its SHA-256 signature.
- **Verify integrity** — download the original file, compute its SHA-256 locally, and compare it to the published value. A match proves the file is unaltered.
- **Cross-reference the source** — where a registry link is provided (for example oss.go.id, ahu.go.id, or satusehat.kemkes.go.id), follow it to confirm the details on the official government portal.

---
